proof_details.C:nonnoetherian-henselian-lifting: Both left and right multiplication by 1-uh are surjective by Nakayama, giving a two-sided inverse without Noetherianity. Finite monogenic commutative subalgebras remain products of henselian local rings; unit reflection places radical intersections correctly. Exact idempotent and self-adjoint square-root lifts yield source/category form classification.
proof_details.C:effective-coherent-henselization-WG: Every pointed monic-etale neighborhood is a localization of an explicit finite free B-algebra. Tensor neighborhoods stay finite free before localization. The actual B-kernel of multiplication computes annihilators, and localization plus faithful flatness decides equality from finitely many residue tests. Cleared-denominator B-linear kernels of C-matrices base change to full actual henselization kernels. Finite actual End rings permit the new non-Noetherian lifting lemma, so all finite/C1 classifiers remain ordinary.
proof_details.C:lexicographic-valuation-henselization-: Finite matrix diagonalization uses only total decidable divisibility and allowed division. Equal- and mixed-characteristic lex valuations, rational-function equality, residues and residue lifts are explicit. The smallest positive value is e_r, while x1/y^n has positive value for every n. Faithful henselization preserves the nonzero intersection and normal domain. Krull intersection both excludes Noetherianity and excludes every filtered flat local Noetherian-stage presentation via ideal contraction.
